assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original wide illustration for the header of TwoSpace, a private app for long-distance couples. Create a sophisticated, beautifully composed gouache and cut-paper illustration of two different cozy rooms seen through two large arched windows, one in soft daytime and one at night, with a tiny flowing ribbon visually connecting the two separate spaces. Each room has a chair, a lamp, a plant, a book and a mug; the chairs remain in separate rooms. No people. The image should convey sharing everyday life across distance without suggesting future in-person reunion. Rich ink blue, persimmon orange, butter yellow, muted sky blue, warm white paper. Confident flat shapes, imperfect ink edges, delicate paper texture, exceptional editorial illustration craft. Wide 3:1 composition, the windows and objects occupy the right two-thirds, spacious pale warm-white negative space on the left for real UI controls. No words, letters, hearts, sparkles, gradients, watermark, UI, or fake text. This is final production artwork, not a website screenshot.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: subtle full-bleed website background texture for TwoSpace. A high quality warm-white handmade paper surface, almost ivory #faf8f3, with very subtle natural paper fibers and faint cool blue daylight near the far upper right edge and a trace of warm peach at the far lower left edge. Extremely restrained, bright and quiet, not a gradient design, not marble, not noise overlay, no objects, no shapes, no words, no borders or vignette. This image must support dark text and white content sheets. Wide landscape composition.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied transparent TwoSpace cream-and-rose logo. Remove the dirty circular smudge and all mottling, grain, haze, gradients, edge debris and stray pixels. Preserve the existing two offset rounded arch silhouettes, their relative heights, narrow curved transparent gap, rounded bottom corners, and balanced proportions. Each silhouette must be one uniform flat solid fill all the way through: warm cream #F1E5D5 for the taller left/back arch, muted rose pink #C9859A for the shorter right/front arch. Crisp smooth antialiased edges, completely clean vector-like visual appearance, solid opaque interiors with no texture whatsoever. Single centered symbol occupying about 86% of a square canvas. Transparent background including the gap. No tile, border, shadow, glow, 3D, lighting, inner highlight, indentation, spot, circle, watermark, or text. This is the final production logo artwork; only clean its surfaces and edges, do not redesign it.

Use case: logo-brand. Final clean TwoSpace logo on a perfectly uniform solid charcoal background color #131315, opaque square image, NO transparency. Recreate the two cream and rose rounded arch silhouettes shown in the reference. Preserve their proportions and narrow curved dark separation. Taller warm cream arch on the left/back, shorter rose pink arch on the right/front, both bottoms aligned. Draw two mathematically smooth shapes using uniform solid cream #F1E5D5 and uniform solid rose #C9859A. All surfaces completely clean and even. Every interior pixel of each shape should be visually the same color. No texture, no gradients, no lighting, no 3D, no circular marks or indentation, no smudges, no shadows, no noise, no flecks, no white fringes, no extra objects. Crisp antialiased smooth edges against the charcoal background. Centered mark with equal 8% margin in square. No text, border, watermark, rounded outer tile, or perspective. Brand production artwork.
assets.export: 1024px opaque PNG; scripts/build-brand-icons.mjs creates mobile, browser, Apple touch, and ICO copies.
